author: Unity
description:
Unity Addressables makes it easy to manage and load your game assets asynchronously. It optimizes memory usage, reduces load times, and simplifies the process of releasing remote updates or DLC without rebuilding the entire game. In this deep-dive video, we show you how to get started with configuring your assets and mastering advanced cloud content delivery.

author: Unity
description:
This video provides an introductory walkthrough of the Render Graph API in Unity’s Universal Render Pipeline (URP) using the Render Graph samples. Render Graph, introduced in Unity 6, is a programming interface designed to manage GPU resources and rendering passes efficiently, replacing the older scriptable render passes.

Sample Walkthroughs:
💠Blit: This is the most basic pass. It allocates a temporary texture, copies data from a source to a target, and demonstrates how Render Graph can automatically merge passes.
💠Blit with Material: This approach uses AddBlitPass to apply a shader during the copy process. It is categorized as an "unsafe pass" because Render Graph’s automatic optimization cannot fully manage the resource handling.
💠Frame Buffer Fetch: This technique samples data directly from the GPU buffer without copying it to main memory, which is faster and more memory-efficient.
